settings.alerts.groupLibraryHint: Downloads, imports and problems. Email goes to staff.
settings.alerts.title: Alerts
settings.alerts.lead: Everyone also gets these messages inside HolyArrs, on their Requests page. For email and Discord, each person adds their address or Discord user ID in My account.
settings.alerts.name: Name
settings.alerts.hookLinkHint: Gets a JSON post for each Alert
settings.alerts.secretHint: Optional. Retype it if the link moves to another server.
settings.alerts.authBearer: Is sent as a bearer token (Authorization header)
settings.alerts.botTokenNew: In Telegram, talk to @BotFather and send /newbot; it gives you the token. Kept encrypted and never shown again.
settings.alerts.keptKeep: Kept encrypted and never shown again. Leave empty to keep the stored one.
settings.alerts.chatIdHint: A user, group or channel ID, or @channel. Message the bot or add it first.
settings.alerts.ntfyServerHint: Empty uses ntfy.sh. A home server needs “Reach the local network”.
settings.alerts.topicHint: Letters, digits, - and _. Anyone with this name can read it.
settings.alerts.accessTokenNew: Optional, only for a topic that needs a sign-in. In ntfy: Account, Access tokens. Kept encrypted and never shown again.
settings.alerts.keptKeepServer: Kept encrypted and never shown again. Leave empty to keep the stored one; another server needs it typed again.
settings.alerts.removeTokenHint: When the topic no longer needs one
settings.alerts.gotifyServerHint: A home server needs “Reach the local network”
settings.alerts.gotifyTokenNew: In Gotify: Apps, Create application, then copy its token. Kept encrypted and never shown again.
settings.alerts.userKeyHint: Top of your pushover.net page. Group keys work too.
settings.alerts.pushoverTokenNew: On pushover.net: Create an Application, then copy its API token. Kept encrypted and never shown again.
settings.alerts.discordLinkHint: Channel settings › Integrations › Webhooks › Copy link
settings.alerts.staffHint: Hear about new requests. Requesters get their own email.
settings.alerts.localHint: For a server on this machine or your home network
settings.alerts.noneText: Send messages to Discord, Telegram, email and more.
settings.alerts.packsNote: When one download brings several episodes
settings.alerts.onePackHint: Lists every episode it brought, one per line.
